name: qp_umlaut_alias_marks
note: The ctest opens a fresh InputSession per case; here one session types each key and cancels, which commits nothing until the final nue selection (AC6). AC6 (:355-365) expects the nve row to reach weight 101: that comes from InputSession's unconfigured-frequency compatibility path (core/input_session.cpp:1296-1305), which the public Session never takes because it always calls set_frequency_adjustment (core/session.cpp:22). Through the public Session (default mode Disabled) the weight stays 100.
